module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil
/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 316

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture316

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 316](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

Let `G` be a simple connected graph and let `P` denote the set of pendant vertices
(vertices of degree 1). If `|P| ≥ deg_avg(Gᶜ)`, then `G` is well totally dominated,
where `deg_avg(Gᶜ)` is the average degree of the complement of `G`.

**Proof sketch.** In the trivial cases (`P = ∅`, or at most `2` vertices) `G` is complete,
and complete graphs are well totally dominated. Otherwise the set `C` of non-pendant
vertices satisfies `|C| ≤ 3` and is a clique of `G`, and a case split on the set `Q ⊆ C`
of neighbours of pendant vertices shows that `G` is well totally dominated.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5,
  formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/KitaKen1/wowii-graph-conjecture-316-lean/blob/3335e07151bc43e86d5c104dd30fee3596f06410/GraphConjecture316.lean"]
theorem conjecture316 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.Connected)
    (h : (averageDegree Gᶜ : ℚ) ≤ (pendantVertices G).card) :
    IsWellTotallyDominated G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The average degree of the edgeless graph on 3 vertices is 0. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : averageDegree (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) = 0 := by
  unfold averageDegree; simp [Fintype.card_fin]

/-- In `P₃` (path 0-1-2), the average degree is 4/3 and there are 2 pendant vertices. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : averageDegree (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {s(0,1), s(1,2)} : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) = 4/3 := by
  unfold averageDegree
  decide +kernel

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture316

reformulations.difference: The conclusion uses `IsWellTotallyDominated G` := all inclusion-minimal total dominating sets have equal cardinality, whereas WOWII Definition 99 defines 'G well total dominated' as 'every minimal total dominating set is a minimum total dominating set'.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: (→) Given minimal S and any TDS T, T contains an inclusion-minimal TDS T' (finite strong induction); |S| = |T'| ≤ |T|, so S is minimum. (←) For minimal S, T, the source condition gives |S| ≤ |T| and |T| ≤ |S|. Holds for every finite graph (both sides vacuous if no TDS exists). Proved in Lean as `isWellTotallyDominated_iff_source` (scratch file /workspace/review/equiv.lean), together with the corollary that the file's theorem implies the source-phrased conclusion.

reformulations.difference: The source restricts to 'a simple connected graph with n > 1'; the Lean requires only `G.Connected` (so n ≥ 1) and has no `[Nontrivial α]` (contrast with the history of PR #1256, which added `Nontrivial` to other WOWII files because their single-vertex case was false).
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For a one-vertex graph no total dominating set exists (a TDS needs every vertex to have a neighbour in it), so `IsWellTotallyDominated G` holds vacuously and the n = 1 instance is trivially true. Hence the universally quantified statement with and without `[Nontrivial α]` are equivalent. Proved in Lean as `statement_iff_nontrivial` (scratch file /workspace/review/equiv.lean).

review.notes:
Source verification: the cited WOWII site was unreachable (HTTPS port timed out; web.archive.org and index.commoncrawl.org are firewalled in the sandbox, and I did not try to get around that). I took the exact wording of Conjecture 316 from a byte-level copy of WOWII's open.html (accessed 2026-07-28, from Zenodo records 22559106/22211488). Its SHA-256 matches the hash published in Zenodo record 21650036. An independent public transcription (Kuberwastaken/c5-k4) gives the same text: "Let G is a simple connected graph with n > 1. Let P be the pendant vertices of G. If |P| ≥ deg_avg(G̅), then G is well total dominated." It sits in WOWII's section "Sufficient conditions ... every minimal Total Dominating Set is a minimum Total Dominating Set". The file's history is consistent with this: PR #4171 changed deg_avg(G) to deg_avg(Gᶜ). The earlier version was false; P5 is a counterexample (|P| = 2 ≥ 8/5, but it has minimal total dominating sets of sizes 3 and 4).

Status: WOWII still shows the 'O' (open) marker for 316 as of 2026-07-28. The file's `research solved` tag rests on the linked external Lean proof. I compiled that proof (pinned commit 3335e071) against this checkout. It uses only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] and closes the file's exact statement with the file's own definitions (unchanged since the commit the proof targeted). So the solved tag is justified under CONTRIBUTING's 'formally proved elsewhere' rule. The source's marker simply hasn't been updated, so this is not a stale tag in the file.

Test examples: both `example`s are correct. The P₃ docstring also mentions '2 pendant vertices', which that example does not check. This is harmless.

Some third-party write-ups I read mention the Formal Conjectures listing. I used them only for the WOWII source text and definitions, not for any assessment of this file.
